title: has anyone actually used ai tools for intraday trading?
author: chaii_biscuit
selftext:
seeing a lot of ai-based trading tools these days that claim to help with stock selection, market analysis, entry and exit signals, backtesting and even automated execution.

has anyone here actually used any such tool for intraday trading in the indian market? did it genuinely improve your decision-making, or was it mostly marketing and random signals?

not looking for guaranteed profits or paid promotions. just want to know which tools are genuinely useful, how you use them and what your experience has been.

would especially appreciate recommendations from people trading in equity intraday or f&o.

comments.author: Awkward_Weather5721
comments.body: if u want for research and backtest analysis, i would look into how finny works, [https://finnyai.tech](https://finnyai.tech), there oss trading tool is really unique and creates a validation loop that catches hallucination made by ai.
